title: parse_state_data: four identical SseEvent::Unknown return arms
description: parse_state_data has four separate return SseEvent::Unknown { event_type: event_type.to_owned() } arms: JSON parse failure, non-object value, missing changed field, and changed field deserialization failure. All four produce the same result. Could be refactored with a ? operator on a helper that returns Option<SseEvent>: fn try_parse(event_type: &str, data: &str) -> Option<SseEvent> { let mut v = serde_json::from_str::<Value>(data).ok()?; let obj = v.as_object_mut()?; let changed_val = obj.remove("changed")?; let changed = serde_json::from_value(changed_val).ok()?; Some(SseEvent::StateChange(push::StateChange { changed })) } then parse_state_data = try_parse(...).unwrap_or(SseEvent::Unknown { ... }).
